attention_mask: abs(i-j)>W forbidden; self and both directions allowed; no causal/padding mask
execution: CUDA graph; fused AdamW; no mixed precision; no early stop
strict_criterion: Unchanged audit from experimental 1; continuous test<=10% from first train>=99% for at least10k; first90 minus last contiguous low point is positive and less than half plateau. width_10_90 separately first10 to first90.
initialization: T1 identical to original bridge at step0; T2 deletes FFN/norm2 after identical initialization, preserving every shared parameter including both attention blocks.
mechanism: Apply unchanged conditional decomposition, actual head ablations and position replacement to every run whose final test accuracy is >=90%; final endpoint is 150k(T1) or100k(T2).
stop_rule: All 18 runs reach their fixed budget. No early stopping. No extra wd=1 attention-only runs in this batch.
